content: {"like":["Values flexibility and customization in activities (e.g., adjustable workout distances, optional instructions),","Prefers engaging, upbeat, and varied entertainment that blends familiar elements with innovative twists (e.g., musical changes, creative choreography),","Appreciates high-quality visual and narrative craftsmanship (beautiful animation, faithful dialogue, well-cast actors, classic timelessness),","Enjoys lighthearted, endearing holiday stories with clear, predictable plots and charming characters,","Seeks supportive, encouraging personalities in guides or performers (e.g., low‑key, bubbly instructors)."],"dislike":["Dislikes missing or unreliable accessibility features (e.g., promised closed‑captioning not provided),","Finds disorienting or poorly executed filming angles frustrating,","Rejects subpar acting or performances that feel abysmal,","Prefers a balanced focus on story over excessive visual flair (e.g., too much animation at expense of plot),","Is annoyed by overly rapid or short segments that require quick adaptation or practice."]}
